findings.source_quote: The Dayspring shineth from on high,
findings.translation_quote: Die Oggendster skyn van bo af,

findings.source_quote: Extol and praise His worthy name!
findings.suggested_fix: Verhef en prys sy waardige naam!
findings.translation_quote: Verheug en prys sy waardige naam!

findings.source_quote: And worship Him with reverent praise;
findings.suggested_fix: En aanbid Hom met eerbiedige lof;
findings.translation_quote: En diens Hom met eerbiedige lof;
